manifest_metadata.campaign_name: AV1 Library Group Inventory and Expanded Baseline Campaign
manifest_metadata.framework_notice: The filename reflects the broader campaign framework; the included results are Hallowed→AV1-only comparisons due to reference availability.
manifest_metadata.purpose: Extend empirical quality-baseline evidence for discovered unmeasured, candidate, and review AV1 release groups against the accepted Hallowed 2160p x265 baseline.
manifest_metadata.acceptance_premise: Within this multi-group objective-metric corpus, Hallowed 2160p x265 is evaluated as the user's practical quality baseline. AV1 encodes are assessed for incremental quality loss in difficult content (near-black shadows, 35mm grain, high motion, textures, smoke/fog) without universal numeric thresholds or unverified claims of source transparency.
manifest_metadata.explicit_limitation: All six included Op 944A measurements are Hallowed→AV1-only comparisons. No higher-quality reference was available for these selected pairs, so Op 944A does not add new three-way baseline evidence or establish direct reference→AV1 performance.
manifest_metadata.guardrails: Strict evidence-only scope. Zero changes to active tiers, profile scores, Custom Formats, release restrictions, or evidence/verdicts.csv.

planned_titles.title: X-Men: Dark Phoenix
planned_titles.av1_identity: X-Men Dark Phoenix-2019-UHD BluRay AV1 10bit HDR10 AC3 5.1 AV1-ChopperHitler (6.32 GB, 7.40 Mbps)
planned_titles.parity_assessment: 100% same-master UHD BluRay parity. Both files match 3840x1604 active canvas and 23.976 fps. Peak PSNR-Y 46.46 dB at 0 ms offset.
planned_titles.rationale: Extends ChopperHitler evidence beyond the initial 3 catalog titles (X-Men 1, DOFP, Apocalypse) into a modern 2019 Arri Alexa 6.5K digital capture with complex volumetric cosmic particles and space darkness.
